# CodesbyFebin

> Febin Francis ("CodesbyFebin") is a systems engineer and open-source developer based in
> Kerala, India, specializing in AI infrastructure, verifiable compute with STARK proofs,
> and sovereign self-hosted systems. He builds systems that give people more control,
> privacy, and freedom. Principle: PROOF > PROMISES.

## Core pages & portfolio
- **Portfolio** (https://codesbyfebin.vercel.app/portfolio-complete.html): comprehensive multi-section portfolio with Home, About, Systems, Projects, Blog, and Research sections
- **Projects** (https://codesbyfebin.vercel.app/portfolio-enhanced.html): interactive project showcase with category filtering and live search across 6 core systems
- **Original Portfolio** (https://codesbyfebin.vercel.app/portfolio.html): 20+ public repositories with technology stack and links
- **Home** (https://codesbyfebin.vercel.app/index.html): landing page with featured systems and latest work

- **GitHub** (https://github.com/CodesbyFebin): all public repositories
- **ORCID** (https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8123-1531): publications and research profile
- **LinkedIn** (https://linkedin.com/in/codes-by-febin/): professional profile

## Key facts & systems

### Flagship: rust-stark-zkvm
- Zero-knowledge VM with Winterfell STARK proving and verification
- HTTP prove/verify API for remote proving
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools for AI agents
- CI proof gates for automated verification
- Status: Active, production-ready
- Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/rust-stark-zkvm
- Language: Rust

### Second: Decentralized.Host
- Self-hosted deployment mesh with sovereign control
- WireGuard overlay networking for secure connectivity
- DNS-01 TLS automation for encrypted access
- Declarative YAML manifests for infrastructure-as-code
- Raft consensus for distributed coordination
- Chaos and conformance testing framework
- Status: Active
- Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/decentralized-host
- Language: Rust

### Third: AI Infrastructure Stack
- Local inference gateway (OpenAI-compatible API)
- Declarative prompt policy engine for agent safety
- STARK-verified agent action receipts for auditability
- Support for local model serving and privacy-preserving inference
- Status: Active
- Multiple repositories: ai-gateway, prompt-policy-engine, mcp-prove-verify

### Fourth: decentralized.hosting (Public Platform)
- Template registry for sovereign deployments
- Guided onboarding for self-hosting
- Sovereign directory and community platform
- Exit-portability standard for data freedom
- Status: Active

## Technology stack
- Primary: Rust (systems, proofs, infrastructure)
- Secondary: TypeScript/Go (APIs, agents, tooling)
- Infrastructure: WireGuard, Docker, Traefik, FastAPI
- Cryptography: STARK proofs, Winterfell, finite-field arithmetic
- AI: MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM agent integration
- DevOps: Declarative manifests, chaos testing, audit logging

## Focus areas
- **Verifiable Compute**: Zero-knowledge proofs, STARK proving systems, cryptographic verification
- **Sovereign Infrastructure**: Self-hosted deployment, infrastructure control, privacy preservation
- **Agentic Systems**: AI agent frameworks, model routing, evaluation frameworks
- **Developer Tools**: MCP protocols, CLI tools, agent integration
- **Field Systems**: Deployed systems with operational constraints and real-world deployment
